_comment: Frontend configuration, fetched by the browser at startup.
Api.BaseUrl IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY, and leaving it empty is the supported default.
With no value here the app registers its in-memory mock provider and behaves exactly
as it has since it was built: no network call, no hub, no dependency on anything.
Set BaseUrl to a running API's root (for example http://localhost:5226/ locally, or the
Azure App Service URL once one exists) to have the same screens read from that API
Api.Token is NOT a secret and is NOT security. It is a fixed string the API compares
against, published in the repository and shipped to the browser on purpose. See
